title: Nova Studio — Creative Studio for Branding, Motion and Web
description: An editorial landing page for an independent creative studio. A giant discipline index with a pointer-following, velocity-tilted reel preview, a curved 3D work reel, a before/after rebrand case study, a pinned services story and a brief you sign by hand.
sections: Hero discipline index with live reel preview
features: Pointer-following preview card that tilts with velocity and plays each discipline's mini reel
Curved 3D poster reel you can drag and fling
Before / after rebrand slider with keyboard support
Pinned scroll story with palette deck, scrub fields, exploding layers and a glass lens
Project brief with capsule toggles, segmented controls and a hand-signed card
Hydration-safe, reduced-motion aware, no remote assets
